title: Thai Sous Vide Chicken Wrap
description: A Thai-inspired dish featuring sous vide chicken, crispy casabe, and creamy buttermilk sauce.
instructions: 2. Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and garlic.
3. Seal chicken in a sous vide bag and cook for 1 hour.
4. In a bowl, whisk together buttermilk, lime juice, and soy sauce.
5. Once chicken is cooked, remove from bag and slice into strips.
6. Add chicken to the buttermilk mixture and toss to coat.
7. Toast casabe pieces in a toaster or under the broiler until crispy.
8. Assemble wraps by placing a few slices of chicken, some toasted casabe, and a dollop of buttermilk sauce inside each wrap.
